definition.text: Light, the father of Kish (1 Chr. 8:33). 1 Sam. 14:51 should be read, “Kish, the father of Saul, and Ner, the father of Abner, were the sons of Abiel.” And hence this Kish and Ner were brothers, and Saul and Abner were first cousins (comp. 1 Chr. 9:36).

lemmas.gloss: Abinadab, the name of four Israelites
Kish, the name of five Israelites
Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
